title: Jordanians Send Anti-Terror Message Through Theater
main_content:
In Jordan, some people are using theater to suggest a different path from terrorism.

The goal is to use actors to show dangers facing young people who join the Islamic State or other terrorist groups.

“Our role is to produce plays, TV drama, tackling the danger of extremism,” a Jordanian actor told VOA.

The goal is to offer another view than the one presented by terrorist groups through social media.

He said terrorists are using social media “to seduce youth.”

A Jordanian actress said she is playing a mother trying to protect her children from extremism.

The theater group aims its shows at university students. The group mixes serious messages with humor.

The actors say they cannot get their message across if they take a serious tone throughout the shows.

questions.question: What is the goal of the theater group?
options: To encourage young people to join extremist groups
To produce content that distracts from social issues
To offer an alternative perspective on the dangers of extremism
To entertain university students without any serious messages
questions.answer: To offer an alternative perspective on the dangers of extremism
